name: trading-ads-rulebook
title: Trading Ads Rulebook, edition 2026-Q4
description: Ad policy rules for forex and CFD brokers, crypto exchanges and prop trading firms on 7 ad platforms in 16 markets, with quotes from official policy pages and a change log for 2025 to 2026.

fields.name: row_id
fields.description: Unique id: platform code, product code, market code.

fields.name: edition
fields.description: Dataset edition. This file is 2026-Q4.

fields.name: platform_id
fields.description: Short platform id: google_ads, meta, microsoft_ads, tiktok, x, linkedin, reddit.

fields.name: platform
fields.description: Platform name.

fields.name: product
fields.description: forex_cfd (forex and CFD brokers), crypto_exchange (crypto exchanges and wallets), prop_firm (prop trading firms with paid challenges).

fields.name: market
fields.description: Market code: ISO 3166 alpha 2, or EEA_OTHER (EEA countries other than Germany) or ROW (platform default where no country rule applies).

fields.name: market_name
fields.description: Market name in plain words.

fields.name: status
fields.description: The strictest gate that applies. One of: allowed, restricted, no_specific_rule, licence_needed, verification_needed, written_permission_needed, not_allowed, unclear.

fields.name: requirement
fields.description: What an advertiser must do, in plain words.

fields.name: accepted_regulators
fields.description: Regulators the platform names for this market, if any.

fields.name: targeting_limits
fields.description: Age or targeting limits the platform names, if any.

fields.name: policy_title
fields.description: Title of the official policy page.

fields.name: policy_url
fields.description: Link to the official policy page.

fields.name: policy_quote
fields.description: Short verbatim quote (25 words or fewer) from the official page that supports the status. "..." marks a cut.

fields.name: quote_verified
fields.description: yes = quote matched against the live page in a browser on 2026-10-07; manual_check = not yet matched.

fields.name: effective_date
fields.description: Date the rule took effect, when the platform states it. Blank if not stated.

fields.name: checked_on
fields.description: Date the page was checked.

fields.name: notes
fields.description: Extra context, exceptions and our reading where the page is not explicit.

fields.name: confidence
fields.description: high = quoted from the official page for this market; medium = official global rule applied to this market; low = rule is ambiguous or the page could not be fully read.

fields.name: date
fields.description: Date of the policy change or notice.

fields.name: date_precision
fields.description: day, or month when the source gives only a month (date set to the 1st).

fields.name: platform_id
fields.description: Short platform id.

fields.name: platform
fields.description: Platform name.

fields.name: product
fields.description: forex_cfd, crypto_exchange, prop_firm, or all_financial.

fields.name: markets
fields.description: Market codes, comma separated, or global.

fields.name: change
fields.description: What changed, in plain words.

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Where the change was published.

fields.name: source_type
fields.description: platform_notice (official) or press.
